name: Military Officer
description: The Aslan military officer caste is notoriously aggressive, pushing for a military solution to every problem. The strict rules of conduct limit the destructive effects of warfare. The Assassin path is also part of this career — highly trained Aslan warriors who fight the shadowy wars of assassins.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: You command a host of Aslan warriors.

executive_officer.name: Executive Officer
executive_officer.description: You advise male generals on technical and administrative matters.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: You are the unseen claw of your clan.

mishaps.1: Severely injured. Roll twice on the Injury table and take the lower result.
mishaps.2: A failing on your part causes a catastrophic loss for your clan. You are Outcast, and drop to SOC 2.
mishaps.3: A shift in clan politics ruins your career. Lose SOC-2.
mishaps.4: You are defeated in battle. Gain the foe who defeated you as a Rival.
mishaps.5: You are captured by a rival clan and ransomed back but the disgrace ends your career. Gain a Contact in the rival clan.
mishaps.6: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You fight a brutal ground war. Gain Stealth 1, Heavy Weapons 1, Vacc Suit 1 or Drive 1.
events.4: You must discipline a disobedient junior officer. Roll Persuade or Melee (Natural) 8+. If you succeed, gain them as an Ally. If you fail, lose SOC-1 and they become a Rival.
events.5: You garrison one of the richest Aslan worlds. Gain one of Carouse 1, Streetwise 1, Independence 1 or Survival 1.
events.6: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Aslan Life Events table.
events.8: You have the opportunity to establish a landhold in your name. Gain TER +2.
events.9: After a battle, you capture an enemy commander. You may ransom them back and gain TER +2, or free them and gain them as a trusted Ally.
events.10: You are challenged to a duel by a rival. If you refuse, you lose 1D SOC. Accept and roll Melee 8+. If you fail, you lose all Benefits from this term. Succeed, and gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll.
events.11: Your deeds are legend among the cubs of your clan. Either gain Tactics (Military) 1, or DM+4 to your next advancement roll.
events.12: Your efforts strike a great blow for your clan. You are automatically promoted.

mustering_dm_notes: DM+1 if SOC 9+. DM+1 when rolling on Benefits if Male.
